verdict.rationale: Sardine is an API-driven fraud and risk platform. Its own docs say verification and transaction monitoring can run programmatically through APIs, with async webhook events, rather than through the dashboard, so headless use is possible in principle. That evidence is thin: nothing describes CI pipeline use, a CLI, or automation tooling. Missing for 10: CI/CD integration guidance, CLI or headless runner, documented API-key/service-account auth for unattended jobs, public API reference detail, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Business verification can be done through the Middesk or Sardine dashboard as well as via the async /businesses API.
Sardine can digest transaction data from our clients' platforms through its flexible APIs
Our protected documentation includes: step-by-step integration guides, API references, SDKs, sample apps
